business.description: Libord Securities Limited is a listed company engaged in financial services. The company's turnover increased significantly due to favourable business environment.

outlook.statement: The Company expects a favourable economic environment in the current financial year. Indian economy demonstrated strong resilience during FY 2025-26 with Real GDP growth of 7.7% and Nominal GDP growth of 8.9%. Outlook for India's financial services industry remains strong, growth-oriented, and digitally driven, even as the sector faces risks from global volatility, capital flows, cyber risks and AI-led disruption.

The Company is fairly optimistic in its outlook for the year 2025-26. The economy is expected to achieve a steady rate of growth and the Company aims at maximising the shareholders' wealth amidst more favourable business conditions emerging therein.

risks: The Company has not identified any element of risk which may threaten the existence of the Company.
The Company is exposed to market risk, credit risk and liquidity risk.

auditor.name: RMR & Co., Chartered Accountants
auditor.opinion: Unqualified opinion - the standalone Ind AS financial statements give a true and fair view in conformity with the accounting principles generally accepted in India.
key_audit_matters: Fair Value of Investment - The Company's investments (other than investment in Group Companies) are measured at fair value at each reporting date. Auditor assessed the Company's process to compute the fair value of various investments and independently obtained market quotations for quoted instruments.
